title: Select primary user and primary problem
decision: Primary user is the owner-operator of a mahalla grocery shop who sells on credit; primary problem is PROB-001 (late or unpaid credit). Both are provisional until shopkeeper interviews are completed.
context: Desk research found consistent but unmeasured support for PROB-001 in Uzbekistan and quantified support only from one Mumbai study; no field interviews have been done
chosen_option: Shop owner as primary user, PROB-001 as primary problem, provisional
rationale: PROB-001 is the only problem supported by Uzbekistan-specific sources (EVID-001, EVID-014) and matches the approved vision; EVID-015 and EVID-016 point the same way in comparable markets
